assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down pixel-art game TILE ATLAS. Create exactly EIGHT columns by SEVEN rows of equal-sized square cells, perfectly aligned, no gaps, no margins, no grid lines, no text. Overall image aspect ratio 8:7. Each cell depicts 32x32 logical pixel art, magnified with crisp nearest-neighbor pixels, two flat shades, restrained readable texture, no gradients or blur. Each row is a distinct biome. Column order identical in every row: 1 plain walkable ground (very sparse texture), 2 compact walkable path, 3 visibly rough slow ground, 4 impassable water or void, 5 impassable solid wall seen directly from above filling the square, 6 horizontal bridge across the water/void, 7 vertical bridge across the water/void, 8 small decorative prop isolated in center on transparent background. The first seven cells of each row are opaque and fill the complete cell edge-to-edge. ROW 1 FARM: muted green grass, ochre dirt path, dark brown wet mud, turquoise irrigation water, dark green dense hedge, horizontal wooden bridge, vertical wooden bridge, apple tree. ROW 2 DESERT: pale ochre sand, packed tan trail, dark gravel, dark canyon void, sandstone wall, horizontal rope bridge, vertical rope bridge, cactus. ROW 3 FOREST: moss green clearing, leafy dirt path, dark muddy roots, teal stream, dense dark forest wall, horizontal log bridge, vertical log bridge, mushroom stump. ROW 4 SNOW: pale blue snow, packed pale snowy path, deep blue thick snow, dark icy fissure, blue ice wall, horizontal wooden bridge, vertical wooden bridge, small snow-covered pine. ROW 5 VOLCANO: charcoal basalt ground, gray obsidian path, dark ash slow ground, vivid orange lava, dark red basalt wall, horizontal metal bridge over lava, vertical metal bridge, small black rock spire. ROW 6 FACTORY: steel blue metal floor, lighter riveted path, oily dark slow floor, dark industrial shaft, steel machine wall with amber hazard detail, horizontal metal walkway, vertical metal walkway, small industrial crate. ROW 7 SPACE: muted purple moon dust, silver platform path, rocky purple debris, deep indigo space void with TWO tiny stars, dark purple meteor wall, horizontal silver walkway, vertical silver walkway, satellite antenna. Orthographic directly top down, consistent 32-pixel art scale across all 56 cells, cells must remain separate and aligned. Original game artwork. NO scenery, perspective, isometric tiles, labels, border or watermark.

assets.origin: Mechanical crop of the five gameplay object cells from the existing generated source, keeping artwork unchanged.
assets.originalGenerationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production pixel-art character spritesheet. EXACTLY SIX columns by FIVE rows, equal square cells, aligned edge-to-edge with no gaps and no margin. Overall aspect ratio 6:5. Hard crisp pixel art, each cell is 32x32 logical pixels magnified nearest-neighbor. Subject: one charming compact explorer ROBOT, silver-gray rounded square head with dark navy face panel and two cyan eyes, compact cream metal torso, small blue backpack, dark articulated feet, about 23 pixels tall and 18 wide within each 32 pixel cell, feet aligned at y=28. Clear dark pixel outline, 2 flat shades per material, never blur/gradient/soft light. ROW 1: robot facing DOWN/front, columns are idle pose 1, idle pose 2, walk contact left, walk passing left, walk contact right, walk passing right. ROW 2: exact same robot facing LEFT with the same 6 animation poses. ROW 3: same robot facing RIGHT with the same 6 animation poses. ROW 4: same robot facing UP/back with same 6 poses. ROW 5 objects, one per cell: column1 single bright golden faceted diamond GEM with dark outline centered, column2 same GEM with tiny sharp white sparkle, column3 blue start-pad sign low to ground, column4 upright black-and-white checkered finish flag on small base, column5 tiny golden pickup sparkle, column6 small plain silver robot head portrait. All characters/objects must be fully isolated with real alpha=0 outside silhouettes, including gaps between legs, with no background, shadows, checkerboard, halos, text, labels, grid lines or watermark. Preserve exactly 6x5 layout. Original cohesive game-ready artwork.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art HUMAN character spritesheet for a top-down 2D game. Use the attached original human sprite sheet as a STYLE AND SCALE reference only. Generate a fresh sheet with EXACTLY SIX columns by FOUR rows of equal square cells, no margin, no gaps, perfectly aligned; image aspect ratio 3:2. Each cell represents 32x32 logical pixels, magnified with crisp nearest-neighbor edges. Match a classic farming-adventure RPG miniature human: head about 9x9 logical pixels, torso about 8x9, clearly visible human hands and two legs, total figure about 23-26 pixels tall. Dark one-pixel contour and two flat shades per material. No giant heads, gradients, soft light, painted rendering, isometric projection, futuristic robot body or face screens. Subject: human FARMER with a broad straw hat, red hatband, warm tan face, dark brown hair, cream shirt, blue denim overalls and brown boots; keep the original reference farmer identity. Pose layout: ROW 1 faces DOWN/front; ROW 2 faces LEFT; ROW 3 faces RIGHT; ROW 4 faces UP/back. Every row has six poses: idle 0, idle 1, walk left contact, walk left passing, walk right contact, walk right passing. Exactly the same person and outfit throughout, with centered body and shared feet baseline at logical y=28. Walking frames must visibly alternate arms and legs. Eyes must be on the facing side, back row shows back of head/hat and backpack. Actual alpha=0 everywhere outside each character, including between legs; no backdrop, vignette, glow, ground shadows, checkerboard, grid lines, labels, text, logos or watermark. Do not include any objects besides the 24 human character poses.
